decision.explanation: The question asks when the Cathedral of Saint Augustine was 'established.' The term 'established' is ambiguous and could refer to the founding of the parish, the completion of the current building, or the elevation to cathedral status. Document D1S4 states that the parish was founded in 1856 and elevated to cathedral status in 1970. Document D2S4 states the parish was founded in 1900 and also elevated to cathedral status in 1970. These conflicting claims about the founding year (1856 vs. 1900) suggest different interpretations of the same entity. However, both documents agree on the cathedral status being granted in 1970. All three dates are valid under different interpretations of 'established' and are supported by direct quotes from the provided sources.
